name: Fang Zhiyou
source:
The protagonist. After losing his parents at the age of nine, he was adopted by his uncle. Fang passed the [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imperial_examination]imperial examination[/url] at a young age and became a scholar. However, he chose to live alone, gave up pursuing an official career, and tried to spend the rest of his life as a writer.

He tried to emulate the Scoffing Scholar of Lanling, who wrote [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jin_Ping_Mei]The Plum in the Golden Vase[/url] inspired by [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Water_Margin]Water Margin[/url]. Similarly, Fang Zhiyou created The Lion Camel Kingdom based on [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Journey_to_the_West]Journey to the West[/url]. However, the death of his friend Su Lianyan shocked him so deeply that he could no longer write. He lost his memories and developed an illness that caused him to see people as beasts. In 1645 on the 24th day of the fourth lunar month, after drinking heavily, he found himself transported to The Lion Camel Kingdom — the very world he had once written about.
